lines.cap: Imagine a machine that could pick every lock on Earth at once.
lines.tts: Imagine a machine that could pick every lock on Earth, at once.

lines.cap: Cryptographers have a name for the day it arrives: Q-Day.
lines.tts: Cryptographers have a name for the day it arrives. Q Day.

lines.cap: We built Shorline to answer one question for Zcash: how much ZEC would survive it?
lines.tts: We built Shorline to answer one question for Zee cash. How much zeck would survive it?

lines.cap: Every coin is guarded by a pair of keys.
lines.tts: Every coin is guarded by a pair of keys.

lines.cap: Your private key is the secret that lets you spend.
lines.tts: Your private key is the secret that lets you spend.

lines.cap: Your public key is like the shape of your lock: anyone may see it.
lines.tts: Your public key is like the shape of your lock. Anyone may see it.

lines.cap: And a transparent Zcash address, a t-address, is only a fingerprint of that lock, called a hash.
lines.tts: And a transparent Zee cash address, a tee address, is only a fingerprint of that lock, called a hash.

lines.cap: Today, turning a public key back into its private key is practically impossible.
lines.tts: Today, turning a public key back into its private key is practically impossible.

lines.cap: But Shor's algorithm, on a large quantum computer, makes it easy. Experts call this breaking the discrete logarithm.
lines.tts: But Shor's algorithm, on a large quantum computer, makes it easy. Experts call this, breaking the discrete logarithm.

lines.cap: What it cannot do is reverse a hash. So while only the fingerprint is public, your coins are safe.
lines.tts: What it cannot do, is reverse a hash. So while only the fingerprint is public, your coins are safe.

lines.cap: Here's the catch.
lines.tts: Here's the catch.

lines.cap: The first time you spend from an address, its public key is written on the blockchain forever.
lines.tts: The first time you spend from an address, its public key is written on the blockchain, forever.

lines.cap: Everything left behind, and anything sent there later, is exposed.
lines.tts: Everything left behind, and anything sent there later, is exposed.

lines.cap: Busy wallets reuse addresses all day, turning safe coins into targets.
lines.tts: Busy wallets reuse addresses all day, turning safe coins into targets.

lines.cap: Zcash is already preparing.
lines.tts: Zee cash is already preparing.

lines.cap: In July, the Ironwood upgrade, ZIP 2005, made new shielded notes recoverable after Q-Day.
lines.tts: In July, the Ironwood upgrade, zip twenty oh five, made new shielded notes recoverable after Q Day.

lines.cap: Funds left in the older Sprout, Sapling and Orchard pools would be stranded.
lines.tts: Funds left in the older Sprout, Sapling, and Orchard pools, would be stranded.

lines.cap: And ZIP 2007 asks which transparent coins could be saved. Its first open task: survey the entire chain. No one had published it.
lines.tts: And zip twenty oh seven asks which transparent coins could be saved. Its first open task: survey the entire chain. No one had published it.

lines.cap: So we built Shorline.
lines.tts: So, we built Shorline.

lines.cap: It streams every Zcash block since 2016 from public lightwalletd servers.
lines.tts: It streams every Zee cash block since twenty sixteen, from public light wallet D servers.

lines.cap: A Rust engine replays all 191 million transparent outputs, rebuilding the UTXO set, the list of unspent coins, and records the moment each address's key went public.
lines.tts: A Rust engine replays all one hundred ninety one million transparent outputs, rebuilding the U T X O set, the list of unspent coins, and records the moment each address's key went public.

lines.cap: No full node. No disk. About thirty minutes.
lines.tts: No full node. No disk. About thirty minutes.

lines.cap: Then it checks itself.
lines.tts: Then, it checks itself.

lines.cap: A zatoshi is the smallest unit of ZEC: one hundred-millionth of a coin.
lines.tts: A zatoshi is the smallest unit of zeck. One hundred millionth of a coin.

lines.cap: Shorline's total matches the Zebra node's transparent value pool to the very last zatoshi.
lines.tts: Shorline's total matches the Zebra node's transparent value pool, to the very last zatoshi.

lines.cap: So, here's the answer.
lines.tts: So, here's the answer.

lines.cap: 7.24 million ZEC, 42.5% of all ZEC in existence, sits behind public keys already on the blockchain.
lines.tts: Seven point two four million zeck. Forty two point five percent of all zeck in existence, sits behind public keys already on the blockchain.

lines.cap: At today's price, that's about $6.8 billion.
lines.tts: At today's price, that's about six point eight billion dollars.

lines.cap: 4.37 million more is only hash-protected: safe until its owner spends.
lines.tts: Four point three seven million more is only hash protected. Safe, until its owner spends.

lines.cap: 749 thousand is stranded in old shielded pools, while 4.18 million is already recoverable in Ironwood.
lines.tts: Seven hundred forty nine thousand is stranded in old shielded pools, while four point one eight million is already recoverable, in Ironwood.

lines.cap: And it's getting worse, not better.
lines.tts: And it's getting worse, not better.

lines.cap: 79% of the exposed coins went public since the start of 2025.
lines.tts: Seventy nine percent of the exposed coins went public since the start of twenty twenty five.

lines.cap: In just nine days this autumn, a million ZEC flipped from safe to exposed, as big holders moved some coins and left the rest behind.
lines.tts: In just nine days this autumn, a million zeck flipped from safe to exposed, as big holders moved some coins, and left the rest behind.

lines.cap: Shorline also finds what block explorers can't see.
lines.tts: Shorline also finds what block explorers can't see.

lines.tts: One set of three keys guards nine hundred ninety six thousand zeck, across thirty nine multi sig addresses, each differing only by a random salt.

lines.cap: Everything is live in an open dashboard.
lines.tts: Everything is live, in an open dashboard.

lines.cap: Paste any address, and Shorline tells you whether it's exposed, privately.
lines.tts: Paste any address, and Shorline tells you whether it's exposed. Privately.

lines.tts: What makes Shorline different?

lines.tts: It's a complete, chain wide survey, that answers an open task from Zee cash's own protocol team.

lines.tts: It proves its numbers to the zatoshi, finds hidden exposure, protects your privacy, and anyone can reproduce it, with one command.
